answer: A bonded-agent registry makes each AI agent post a slashable stake and build a trellis of signed attestations from counterparties. Payouts use a concave reward curve plus cluster-level caps; shared funding, timing, or behavior creates a ripple that links sybils, and rewards route through a common harbor account. Splitting stake across many identities cannot increase total payout because the curve is sublinear and caps aggregate cluster resources, while fake attestations require costly stakes and risk slashing. Limitation: collusion and graph false positives remain.
